findings.message: The `verdict` route calls the real `_verdict` with `journal.read` returning `[]` and `repo=Path("repo")`. As a result `reject_queue(history).get(stem)` is None, and `_verdict` runs `(checkout.repo / ticket_path(stem)).is_file()`. That is a real stat of `repo/tickets/candidate/ticket.md` relative to the process cwd. So a test in `tests/unit/`, which the ticket requires to be fake-backed, reads disk. Its preview branch depends on which directory pytest runs from.
findings.paved_road: Keep the verdict route off the filesystem. One way is to pass a fake `repo` whose `/` returns an object with `is_file()` returning False. Another is to have `checkout.journal.read` return history that puts `candidate` in the reject queue, so `_verdict` takes the `queued` preview branch and never touches a path.
